descriptor: Hyperlocal weather with a day and night mode

voice.summary: Skyline Daily sounds like a neighbour leaning over the fence to say the evening will clear up. It is descriptive and a bit poetic about the sky, but never loses a precise temperature.
dos: Describe the sky in one concrete image
Pair every forecast with a degree and a time
Greet the time of day: morning, dusk, tonight
donts: Do not use meteorological jargon without explaining it
Never promise sun the forecast cannot back

boilerplate: Skyline Daily is a weather app for coastal towns like Pennick Bay that pairs honest forecasts with a theme that turns from day to night as the sun sets.

logo.note: A soft cloud suits a weather app whose personality shifts gently from daylight to dusk.
